title: Verify the European title VRAM loader during startup
changes: Add a targeted cold-start observation and raw/managed CPUSet comparison using the authenticated E517 source plan and the current Europe catalog.
validation: Wine unit dwcnk1hg reaches state 3 at the original loader and drains. Three copies match all 55,528 destination bytes with the selected ROM backing altered. CPUSet arguments, guest clock, audio and full state match. Windows build cqkfw_x8 passes.
limitations: State 1 has controlled-reader coverage and still needs a verified ordinary trigger. Translated execution, original BIOS, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements. Primary Terra/xhigh settings unconfirmed.
